sights.address: Lornie Road / Kheam Hock Road, Novena, Singapore
sights.w: Singapore's largest Chinese cemetery and reputedly the largest outside China: ~100,000 graves on 70–86 ha of overgrown hills, opened as a municipal cemetery on 1 Jan 1922 and closed to burials in 1973. Grand Peranakan and Hokkien tombs with Sikh guardian statues and tiled tablets; partly exhumed in 2012–13 for a highway, which sparked a heritage campaign that now runs free guided walks.
sights.k: Free; join a Brownies heritage walk (weekends); bring insect repellent
